codeList:
$ wget https://raw.githubusercontent.com/milvus-io/milvus/v3.0.5/configs/milvus.yaml
log:
  level: warn
# For Milvus standalone
$ wget https://github.com/milvus-io/milvus/releases/download/v3.0.5/milvus-standalone-docker-compose.yaml -O docker-compose.yml
services:
  standalone:
    volumes:
      - ${DOCKER_VOLUME_DIRECTORY:-.}/volumes/milvus:/var/lib/milvus
      - /local/path/to/your/user.yaml:/milvus/configs/user.yaml   # Map the local path to the container path
$ sudo docker compose up -d
